description: Header file defining exception classes, error handling macros, and warning utilities for the c10 namespace in PyTorch, including Error classes, warning mechanisms, and error-checking macros.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Primary exception class providing error messages with source location and backtrace information.

classes.name: Warning
classes.description: Class representing warnings with types and source location.

classes.name: WarningHandlerGuard
classes.description: RAII guard for setting and restoring warning handlers.

classes.name: ErrorAlwaysShowCppStacktrace
classes.description: Error class that always reports C++ backtrace.

classes.name: IndexError
classes.description: Error class for index out-of-bounds errors.

classes.name: ValueError
classes.description: Error class for invalid value errors.

classes.name: OnnxfiBackendSystemError
classes.description: Error class for Onnxifi backend errors.

classes.name: LinAlgError
classes.description: Error class for linear algebra errors.

classes.name: AcceleratorError
classes.description: Error class for accelerator API errors, includes error code.

methods.name: add_context
methods.description: Adds additional context message to an Error object.

methods.name: backtrace
methods.description: Returns the backtrace associated with an Error.

methods.name: what
methods.description: Returns the complete error message including source location.

methods.name: what_without_backtrace
methods.description: Returns the error message without backtrace.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Issues a warning with a given message.

methods.name: get_warning_handler
methods.description: Gets the current global warning handler.

methods.name: set_warnAlways
methods.description: Configures whether warnings are always shown.

methods.name: get_warnAlways
methods.description: Checks if warnings are always shown.

methods.name: GetExceptionString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of an exception, including type.
